# DEC-20261119-07 — Product SKU is generated by the backend

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Date | 2026-11-19 (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh); recorded 2026-11-25 |
| Source | Product Owner decision (Nguyễn Minh Khôi, Team Leader / acting Product Owner) of 2026-11-19, confirmed at Checkpoint 1 of the SKU / FoodMart seed task on 2026-11-25 |
| Status | OWNER_DECISION, implemented on `dev` by commit `24b9b01` (Duy Phan, 2026-11-20); recorded on branch `Khoi/fix/sku-foodmart-seed` |
| Feature | F02 (product), with effects on F04 import and the demo seed |
| Related | BRD §8 row "2026-11-19 F02 rules" (`d22f735`), DEC-20261124-03 (soft delete), DEC-20261125-02 (source of truth) |

## Context
The 2026-11-19 F02 update (`d22f735`) made the client send a SKU matching `^SKU-[A-Z0-9-]{11}$`. Commit `24b9b01` (2026-11-20) went further: the backend generates the SKU and rejects a client `sku` as an unknown field. The API contract (`docs/api/F02_PRODUCT_INVENTORY_API.md`) and the F02 handoff followed the code, but `SRS.md` FR-02.1, `GLOSSARY.md`, `BRD_VISION.md` and the `paspm-context` skill still described a client SKU. Under DEC-20261125-02 the difference was reported to the PO, who kept the server-generated SKU.

## Decision
1. The backend generates every new Product SKU from the database product ID: `SKU-` followed by the ID padded to 11 digits (`SKU-%011d`, for example `SKU-00000000042`). If that value is already taken, a random 11-character suffix is used instead (`ProductMetadataPersistence.generatedSku`).
2. Clients never send `sku` on Product create or update; sending it is 400 `Invalid request fields`. The SKU is read-only and never changes.
3. Existing SKUs are kept as they are. Databases seeded before 2026-11-20 keep their `FOODMART-xxxx` SKUs; there is **no migration**. Such products can be edited normally, because updates do not touch the SKU.
4. F04 import keeps resolving products by exact SKU within the Store. Datasets that use their own product codes (FoodMart `FOODMART-NNNN`) are mapped to the server SKU outside the backend; the demo seed does this with `mapping.csv` and import-ready CSV copies.
5. The similar-name confirmation (409 `PRODUCT_NAME_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, retry with `confirmSimilarName: true`) and backend-generated batch codes `BATCH-YYYYMMDD-NNN` stay as decided on 2026-11-19.

## Consequences
- The SKU regex rule `^SKU-[A-Z0-9-]{11}$` describes the generated format; it is no longer a client validation rule.
- `SRS.md` FR-02.1, `GLOSSARY.md` (Product), `BRD_VISION.md` §8 and §11, and both `paspm-context` skill copies are updated in the same branch.
- The demo seed creates products by name and reads back the SKU (record ROC-20261125-004).
